provenance.prompt: Purpose: four project-authored wall-mounted mirrors with distinct real mirror contours and solid frame geometry. Specification: fixed installation envelope 0.80m x 1.80m x 0.04m, metres, +Y up, +Z forward, centred wall-contact back at z=0 and identity scale. Functional contract: single planar-mirror-v1 / single-512-v1 reflective face at local z=0.026, node mirror-surface and no lights, occupancy, clock, information or use points. Geometry: finite convex counterclockwise polygons, one coplanar face mesh, complete positive-Z triangulation, closed thick back and closed frames wholly outside declared mirror interiors. Budget: deterministic CPU polygon geometry and Three.js GLB export with CPU GLTFLoader readback, no online dependency and no raster reflection baked into assets. Editable source: per-design contour sampling, frame width, color and surface parameters. Export and provenance: exact source, contract, generator and dependency SHA256 pins. Static GLB mirror face is an inspection surface. Actual host scene reflection is supplied only by the separately verified runtime binding. Design: A .68m by 1.68m rectangular full-length mirror with a continuous deep blue-grey solid rectangular rail frame.
provenance.method: Project-authored deterministic CPU convex polygon triangulation, solid offset ring frames, solid backing and solid mullions. GLB contains static inspection geometry. Runtime binds the actual host-scene Reflector separately.
